fields.description: Tender / contract pipeline (Mikas). OFF by default so other tenants are unaffected.
fields.label: Tender

fields.description: Import/customs declaration pipeline (MSAERP migration). OFF by default so other tenants are unaffected.
fields.label: Imports

fields.description: Agreement master and agreement-level receivables. OFF by default.
fields.label: Agreements

fields.description: Show the measurement columns (length/width/height/pieces) on sales order lines by default. This is a DISPLAY preference only — the quantity of a dimensional item is always computed from its measurements regardless, and the column appears anyway whenever a line's item is dimensional.
fields.label: Dimensional Sales Lines (measure columns by default)

fields.description: New sales order lines auto-select the largest box/case unit of measure (conversion_factor > 1) instead of the stock unit. OFF by default so tenants that sell by the stock unit (dts, horeca) are unaffected; turn on for tenants that sell by the box (anjan).
fields.label: Sales Box/Case UOM Preference

fields.description: Use the redesigned single-column Sales Order form (sticky action bar) instead of the classic two-column form. OFF by default: every tenant keeps the classic form; turn on per tenant to opt into the new design.
fields.label: Modern Sales Order Form

fields.description: Blocks stock-valuation poisoning: mistyped purchase rates, incoming_rate entered in transaction currency, and manufacturing entries valued far above the bin. Thresholds live in Stabler Settings. OFF by default.
fields.label: Valuation Guard

fields.description: Refuse a supplier payment whose bank/cash account is in a different currency than the supplier's payable account. OFF by default: tenants that pay foreign-currency suppliers from a local-currency account rely on the conversion. Turn on per tenant that buys in one currency only.
fields.label: Supplier Payment Currency Guard
